title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go; parity and v1.53.0
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: unify authentication token refresh semantics, retry/backoff behavior, and streaming ergonomics across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs to achieve API parity and prepare for v1.53.0 release. This PR consolidates common logic into a new internal auth/retry adapter, standardizes default retryable status codes and backoff jitter, exposes a consistent streaming callback/async iterator surface across languages, and applies small compatibility fixes found during cross-SDK integration tests. Changes are intentionally backwards-compatible: public signatures are preserved where possible and deprecation notes are added for planned simplifications. Checklist: - [x] design doc (ENG-4231) - [x] implement core adapters in each SDK - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] docs updates and migration notes - [x] version bumps, changelogs - [x] CI green and release smoke testing.
commits_summary: Initial cross-language adapter refactor; python: extract AuthRetryAdapter and add TokenRefresh hook; ts: align retry policy defaults + add streaming iterator wrapper; go: expose StreamReader interface and unify retry middleware; tests: add integration harness for streaming + retry roundtrip; docs: update migration notes and examples; bump versions to v1.53.0.
review_conversation: Priya: Can we keep the default max_retries at 3 for parity with hosted client? Requested: explicit test for token refresh race when streaming. Ava: Added test and updated default to 3; explained adapter preserves legacy behavior unless user opts into new backoff config. Marco: Noted small naming mismatch in TS stream iterator; pushed follow-up commit with rename to `streamIterator` for consistency. Ethan: Verified go interface and suggested minor doc addition for Go consumers; approved after docs update. CI flagged a transient e2e-streaming timeout on first run; flake reproduced locally, adjusted test harness timeout and re-ran. Final: all reviewers approved and PR merged via squash.
release_notes: SDKs: Unify auth token refresh and retry policies across Python/TypeScript/Go
SDKs: Improved streaming ergonomics - consistent async iterator/callback surface
SDKs: Backwards-compatible changes; default max_retries standardized to 3
Other: small parity fixes and version bumps
additional_notes: Rollout: Gradual release - publish packages to PyPI/NPM/Go proxy, run canary clients against staging, monitor error and latency metrics for 72h. Observability: added metric sdk.retry.adapter_applied to help detect clients on legacy vs new behavior. Support: link to SUP-1182 for customers who reported inconsistent streaming reconnect behavior.
notes_for_release_manager: Cut release branch release/v1.53.0 after merge; publish SDK artifacts in order: typescript -> python -> go to minimize cross-language migration issues. Announce breaking items (none) and deprecation notes in changelog.
